--- a/inventory_api/app.py
+++ b/inventory_api/app.py
@@ -78,6 +78,8 @@
 def reserve(body: ReservationIn, user: dict = Depends(current_user)) -> dict:
     if body.sku not in STOCK:
         raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="unknown sku")
+    if body.qty <= 0:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="qty must be positive")
     if body.qty > STOCK[body.sku]:

@@ -93,6 +95,8 @@

     STOCK[reservation["sku"]] += reservation["qty"]

--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_regression_stock_integrity.py
@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+from inventory_api import app as inventory
+from inventory_api.app import app
+
+client = TestClient(app)
+ALICE = {"Authorization": "Bearer token-alice"}
+BOB = {"Authorization": "Bearer token-bob"}
+
+
+def setup_function():
+    inventory.STOCK.update({"A-100": 100, "B-200": 20, "C-300": 3})
+    inventory.RESERVATIONS.clear()
+
+
+def available(sku: str) -> int:
+    return client.get(f"/stock/{sku}").json()["available"]
+
+
+def test_negative_qty_must_not_inflate_stock():
+    resp = client.post("/reservations", json={"sku": "A-100", "qty": -15}, headers=BOB)
+    assert resp.status_code >= 400
+    assert available("A-100") == 100
+
+
+def test_double_cancel_must_not_return_stock_twice():
+    rid = client.post("/reservations", json={"sku": "C-300", "qty": 2}, headers=BOB).json()["id"]
+    assert client.delete(f"/reservations/{rid}", headers=BOB).status_code == 200
+    assert available("C-300") == 3
+    second = client.delete(f"/reservations/{rid}", headers=BOB)
+    assert second.status_code != 200
+    assert available("C-300") == 3

issues.root_cause: Re-cancelling an already-cancelled reservation returns stock again (3->5), and the inflated 5 then allows a 5-unit reservation on 3-unit SKU, matching ticket 2 oversell
issues.title: Cancel endpoint does not check status so double-cancel returns stock twice enabling oversell

findings.summary: Two tickets for inventory_api: A-100 reports more than 100 available, and C-300 oversold with 5 reserved but only 3 exist. H1 and H2 confirmed and fixed by patch adding qty<=0 422 validation and status!=active 410 check. Verification shows both regression tests pass with no regressions, independent review verdict approve.

report.diff:
--- a/inventory_api/app.py
+++ b/inventory_api/app.py
@@ -78,6 +78,8 @@
 def reserve(body: ReservationIn, user: dict = Depends(current_user)) -> dict:
     if body.sku not in STOCK:
         raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="unknown sku")
+    if body.qty <= 0:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="qty must be positive")
     if body.qty > STOCK[body.sku]:
         raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="insufficient stock")
     STOCK[body.sku] -= body.qty
@@ -93,6 +95,8 @@
     reservation = RESERVATIONS.get(reservation_id)
     if reservation is None or reservation["user_id"] != user["id"]:
         raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="reservation not found")
+    if reservation["status"] != "active":
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=410, detail="reservation already cancelled")
     STOCK[reservation["sku"]] += reservation["qty"]
     reservation["status"] = "cancelled"
     log_event(level="INFO", event="cancelled", reservation_id=reservation_id, sku=reservation["sku"],
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_regression_stock_integrity.py
@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+from inventory_api import app as inventory
+from inventory_api.app import app
+
+client = TestClient(app)
+ALICE = {"Authorization": "Bearer token-alice"}
+BOB = {"Authorization": "Bearer token-bob"}
+
+
+def setup_function():
+    inventory.STOCK.update({"A-100": 100, "B-200": 20, "C-300": 3})
+    inventory.RESERVATIONS.clear()
+
+
+def available(sku: str) -> int:
+    return client.get(f"/stock/{sku}").json()["available"]
+
+
+def test_negative_qty_must_not_inflate_stock():
+    resp = client.post("/reservations", json={"sku": "A-100", "qty": -15}, headers=BOB)
+    assert resp.status_code >= 400
+    assert available("A-100") == 100
+
+
+def test_double_cancel_must_not_return_stock_twice():
+    rid = client.post("/reservations", json={"sku": "C-300", "qty": 2}, headers=BOB).json()["id"]
+    assert client.delete(f"/reservations/{rid}", headers=BOB).status_code == 200
+    assert available("C-300") == 3
+    second = client.delete(f"/reservations/{rid}", headers=BOB)
+    assert second.status_code != 200
+    assert available("C-300") == 3
report.verification_scope: Selected/default local tests only; excluded infrastructure tests and unobserved production behavior are not verified.

second_opinion.summary: Patch correctly addresses both root causes: negative qty validation (qty <=0 -> 422) prevents STOCK inflation, and status != active check (410) prevents double-cancel stock duplication. Evidence (logs, repro, code) directly supports H1/H2 and fix is root-cause, not test-specific. No residual flaw found in patched file.

hypotheses.note: Code allows qty<=0, log shows qty -15 accepted and available 90->105, repro returns 201, all consistent with STOCK -= (-15) inflation.
cancel() lacked status check, logs show double DELETE both 200 with 3->5 inflation enabling 5-unit reservation on 3-unit SKU, matching oversell ticket.
